note: Contract 0x1315 routes WETH to POND to USDC through 0xccb4 and then 0xd187 in the front leg. The victim sells POND for USDC on 0xd187, and the back leg exactly unwinds the 8637.163496 USDC, so the bracket is clear. WETH nets +0.035226, less the 0.013165 ETH paid out to 0x99c85 (likely a builder or miner payment), less gas, leaving a small loss. I treated the 0.114227 ETH front-leg transfer from the contract to its own sender as internal to the actor; that choice is the main uncertainty.
